title: Reject stale task evidence when completing a leased agent queue item
problem: A queue item can otherwise be marked complete using success evidence from another attempt, old branch revision or expired lease.
resolution: Bind queue completion to the exact live task and lease attempt, verify current branch/HEAD and evidence provenance, reject stale or unknown claims, and keep corrupt queue state for recovery rather than silently replacing it.
applicability: Agent queues with retries, leased dispatch, checkpoints or PR verification; compare against the implementation-specific current revision and task identity.
doNotUseWhen: No queue or lease exists, or an existing project rule defines a stronger task identity and evidence contract.
